job_spec.name: qkd_static_kv_return_slots_mc_r5-mc5b-ae9c68079
job_spec.purpose: mc5b (Q-KVELEM 10-17): mc5-c6b8639eb EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at 4_1_cts (hold WNS -51.8 frozen on hr/D, 327 violators = input pin flops; repair cannot pad them under recipe 4). Cause: sdc_extra r3 re-set the hclk boundary with the legacy H1 hold form (input min L_min, output min -L_min-50) after the OT_BH die budget. Fix: sdc_extra r5 = r3 + T-IN/T-OUT die budget on the hclk ports under OT_IO_HOLD_BUDGET=die; RTL / pins / outline unchanged. mc5 (Q-KVRET 10-16, rtl_change): main mc_r4 (eb93a6a22) is FUNCTIONALLY WRONG: its one-stage idle_core (current occupancy AND only the previous edge's slot) fails tb_static_return_idle_mc at both phases (+1 ck reference). r5 = mc_r4 regional resets (rs_a/rs_b/rs_c) + mc_r3c two-stage idle_core_pre/idle_hbm_pre. CLOSED mc3c (mc_r3-mc3c-b1633f90c, TT +78.98/FF +13.00) native FAIL launch 223.1 idle_core / 220.7 fault_hbm > 220. Measured on the routed mc3c db (OpenSTA, ot-pve1): every output = pin flop -> INV -> BUF/HB4/BUF out pad -> port BUF (~190 ps fixed, data pins 201-202); idle_core's flop IS at its N-face pin (40.4,212.2) but sits on a lone-sink leaf (clknet_leaf_61: 1 far u_rq flop + idle_core, leaf 71.3 ps vs 47-53) -> clock 251.4 vs 231.6 ps at the E-face pin flops (+20 ps). Fix: (1) RTL: idle_*/fault_* exports are plain pin flops (no async clear, synchronous regional clear rs_c/rs_a/hr), sticky fault state a separate internal flop, so each export Q drives only its port (single-flop anchor, no pin_reg_split copy); (2) clock topology: bounded sink clusters 16 sinks / 30 um + 20 um buffer spacing (as dscoll cesc0 ln: spread 82.3->54.5), so a lone pin-face flop gets a local leaf instead of a long return to a far cluster. (3) slot change: the two drain-observation pins move N -> E face beside fault_*: the mc5 CTS probe with (1)+(2) cleared fault_hbm (220.7 -> <205) but idle_core stayed 223.7 / idle_hbm 215.1 at the lone N-face sinks, every E-face output <=208. (4) coordinator review 10-17 (probe 217.1, 2.9 ps margin): recipe 4 / hold_budget die (FLOW-HOLD) -- no inhold/outhold pads, boundary hold is the die's (pin_regs off: the RTL registers every data pin); ck entry moved S face (x 51.9) -> mid E face (y 107.964) next to the output pin-flop column (actual_* span the whole E face). No pin_reg_split: the RTL gives every export flop its port as the only load (slot_d internal copy of actual_valid). Same outline and mc_r3 grant otherwise; 0 normal-cycle delta on data; drain/fault exports clear one local edge later on reset assertion only. | mc4 (Q-KVSYS-DIE 10-16, rtl_change): native audit of the CLOSED mc3b view (mc_r3-mc3b-d4c0e5fee) FAILS capture on expected_put 259.3 ps > 190 (p_lb 248.7: idle_core compared the RAW expected_put pin) and launch actual_data 221.1 > 220. Fix: idle_core from registered captures only (slot, actual_valid; drain observation one ck edge later, never earlier, no schedule use). Same outline/pins/grant as mc_r3. | Four actual independent phase-aligned pll_hbm_data storage roots: fixed bit slices replace a single >15k storage root; no clock gating, no timing exception between same-phase roots, no normal-cycle delta. Front width259.2 removes measured66.4% utilization failure. | mc3b (Q-ELEM 10-16): mc3-9196b2eb1 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at CTS: the only failing endpoint was idle_hbm (setup -527 / hold -90 ps): raw controller_co[0]/compiled_hbm_put pins fed the idle compare, and idle_hbm was constrained as a core_clk output. Fix: idle_hbm from registered pin captures only (+1 pll_hbm edge on the drain observation, no schedule use) and idle_hbm in the hclk output set.
